input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. A young Japanese woman at a warm whisky bar looks into the camera with a calm neutral face, then her eyes gradually soften and she breaks into a gentle, warm, genuine smile, tilting her head very slightly, as if sharing a secret with a friend. Natural subtle movement, same face and identity throughout, no exaggeration. Warm bokeh lights glimmer softly in the background.
